profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MasonHub
profile.summary: Software engineer with extensive experience in analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of various internet based applications. Proficient in variety of platforms, languages, and embedded systems. Skilled at team collaboration as well as working independently in remote environments. Seeking a challenging software development opportunity in a dynamic environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed, documented, implemented new APIs
•	System and application design and development of the warehouse management system
•	Utilized Golang, GraphQL, PostgreSQL,  Docker,  Heroku, Redis

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Developed and maintained Flex web applications. Responsible for client front end and Java server back end application of multiple projects. 
• Lead developer for multiple projects
• Designed, documented, implemented a new API
• Developer for ICODES Sea Service Deployment Module, used by USDOD
• Utilized Java EE, Apache Tomcat, ActionScript3, FlashPlayer
• Maintain state of software requirements, tasks and bugs in Jira
• Use Git and SVN for software versioning

positions.title: Software Developer in Test
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Kibo is the strategic merger of industry leaders, Marketlive, Shopatron, and Fiverun. With a combined 40 years of innovations, we’re joining forces to help retailers and branded manufacturers unify the consumer experience. Kibo is a complete omnichannel commerce platform, delivering the lowest total cost of ownership and the fastest time to value. With predictive technologies and enterprise performance, we can help you achieve increased sales. No matter the challenge, Kibo powers your success.

• Developed automated regression test suites using Java and Json for new APIs
• Improved coverage by developing new test cases
• Improved tools for current testing
• Conducted code reviews
• Utilized Jira for bug logging, tracking, verifying and as a project management tool
• Tested for functionality, input validation, and data retention
• Extensive use of SQL using DBVisualizer
• Used IntelliJ, Git, Jenkins, TestRail and Advance Rest Client Application
